We now expect Adjusted EBITDA growth of approximately 10% and Adjusted earnings per share growth of low double digits, both excluding reportable catastrophes.

Supported by our strong capital position, we now expect share repurchases of $350 million, while preserving flexibility to invest in attractive growth opportunities across the business,” Demmings added.
